title: Polynomial-Time Halt-Coin Test
statement: For every bit string $z$, evaluate the Boolean test that is true exactly when both of the following hold: the length of the second component of the encoded pair formed from the output of the twelve-fold linear construction and the threefold coin construction exceeds the length of its first component; and the length of the second component of the pair formed from the coin construction and the fourfold linear construction does not exceed the length of its first component. The function sending $z$ to the singleton list containing this test result is computable by a deterministic finite-state Turing machine in time $C(n+1)^c$ on every input of length $n$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not fully define the linear and coin constructions, so their exact bit-string functions cannot be rendered unambiguously.
